description: Cross-citation contract binding the seven Super Agents. Encodes which agents may cite which others, the consent gates that guard each citation, and the citation type (data, action, synthesis, contradiction-flag, memory).

citation_types.data: Read-only data flow; no mutation. Used for context, sources, confidence scores.
citation_types.action: Action delegation; always gated by real-world action consent gates. Used for orchestrator -> executor bridges.
citation_types.synthesis: Synthesis output from one agent consumed as input to another. Always gated by publish_synthesis or equivalent.
citation_types.contradiction-flag: Explicit surface of conflicting information. Gated by publish_synthesis; never silently resolved.
citation_types.memory: Episodic or semantic memory access across agents; append-only; never mutates.

reciprocity_rule.description: When Agent A cites Agent B with reciprocal: true, Agent B may cite Agent A back with the same citation type and matching consent gates. This ensures bidirectional flow across flagship pairs.
reciprocity_rule.enforcement: The safety scanner verifies all reciprocal=true entries have matching reverse entries in the cited agent's citations_to block.

transitive_citation_rules.rule_1: Agent A may cite Agent B's synthesis of Agent C if and only if Agent B is authorised to cite Agent C. No transitive shortcuts.
transitive_citation_rules.rule_2: Contradiction flags are not transitive — only direct source detection triggers a flag. Agent A cannot raise a flag about Agent B raising a flag.
transitive_citation_rules.rule_3: Action citations must complete inline — Agent A -> Agent B -> Agent C action chains are not allowed. Agent A may call Agent B, but Agent B must not delegate further to Agent C unless explicitly authorised in this registry.

consent_gate_mapping.publish_synthesis: The user explicitly approves publishing a synthesis that cites external agents. Gated at the dashboard or CLI level.
consent_gate_mapping.publish_briefing: The user explicitly approves publishing a briefing that cites external agents.
consent_gate_mapping.apply_workflow_change: The user explicitly approves applying a workflow suggestion that may involve external agent citations.
consent_gate_mapping.any_real_world_action: The user explicitly approves any real-world action (PowerShell, web automation, X post, file modification).
consent_gate_mapping.run_powershell_local: The user explicitly approves running a signed PowerShell snippet; may involve citations to other agents' advice.
consent_gate_mapping.run_web_action: The user explicitly approves running a web automation action; may cite external synthesis or data.
consent_gate_mapping.export_provenance_log: The user explicitly approves exporting the provenance log, which may reference other agents.

versioning.migration_path: Supersedes the ad-hoc bridges block in each grok-agent.yaml. Safety scanner validates all grok-agent.yaml bridge entries against this registry at install time.
future_bumps: MINOR: Adding a new lighter agent or changing citation weights
MAJOR: Removing a flagship, changing reciprocity semantics, or tightening transitive rules
